title: The Man Who Spoke to Birds
description: Talking transcends species. The now controversial story of Horace Muntanay, an elderly bird enthusiast who spent his life writing a bird-to-human dictionary.
quote: Did you hear that? They’re saying it may rain soon.
altHero: Horace Muntanay looking up in awe
alt4: chalkboard writing translating squawks and chirps into English phrases
